key: A book about a superhero who fights crime with their best friend.
en: A book about a superhero who fights crime with their best friend.
ja: 親友と一緒に犯罪と戦うヒーローの物語の本。

key: Mother confiscated it because both of them were boys, and almost kissed for some reason.
en: Mother confiscated it because both of them were boys, and almost kissed for some reason.
ja: 二人とも男の子で、しかもなぜかキスしそうになるから、母に取り上げられた。

key: MOTHER: Sigmund, I asked you for something.
en: MOTHER: Sigmund, I asked you for something.
ja: 母: シグムンド、頼みごとをしたはずよ。

key: You can't go outside to play just now.
en: You can't go outside to play just now.
ja: 今は遊びに外へ行っちゃだめ。

key: SIGMUND: I shouldn't go outside right now...
en: SIGMUND: I shouldn't go outside right now...
ja: シグムンド: 今は外に出ちゃいけないんだ……

key: MOTHER: Sigmund, is that you?
en: MOTHER: Sigmund, is that you?
ja: 母: シグムンド、あなたなの?

key: Come, tell us how your first day of school was.
en: Come, tell us how your first day of school was.
ja: こっちへ来て、学校の初日がどうだったか聞かせて。

key: MOTHER: Well, how was it?
en: MOTHER: Well, how was it?
ja: 母: それで、どうだった?

key: FATHER: I trust you had a suitably productive experience?
en: FATHER: I trust you had a suitably productive experience?
ja: 父: それなりに実りある経験ができたと信じているが?

key: SIGMUND: Suitably productive, yes, father.
en: SIGMUND: Suitably productive, yes, father.
ja: シグムンド: はい、それなりに実りがありました、父さん。

key: FATHER: Let us hope it is a more effective learning environment for you than your previous excuse of an educational establishment.
en: FATHER: Let us hope it is a more effective learning environment for you than your previous excuse of an educational establishment.
ja: 父: 前の、教育機関とも呼べない代物よりは、まともな学習環境であることを願うばかりだ。

key: I expect more from you than mere proficiency.
en: I expect more from you than mere proficiency.
ja: 私はお前に、並の習熟以上のものを求めている。

key: Am I understood?
en: Am I understood?
ja: わかったな?

key: SIGMUND: Yes, father.
en: SIGMUND: Yes, father.
ja: シグムンド: はい、父さん。

key: MOTHER: Why don't you bring your sister her tea?
en: MOTHER: Why don't you bring your sister her tea?
ja: 母: お姉ちゃんにお茶を持っていってくれない?

key: The doctor said two cups a day should help brighten her mood.
en: The doctor said two cups a day should help brighten her mood.
ja: お医者様が、一日二杯飲めば気分が明るくなるはずだって。

key: SIGMUND: Yes, mother.
en: SIGMUND: Yes, mother.
ja: シグムンド: はい、母さん。

key: MOTHER: It's sitting over there on the counter. Go on, while it's still warm.
en: MOTHER: It's sitting over there on the counter. Go on, while it's still warm.
ja: 母: あそこのカウンターに置いてあるから。さあ、温かいうちに。

key: MOTHER: The tea, Sigmund?
en: MOTHER: The tea, Sigmund?
ja: 母: お茶よ、シグムンド。

key: Over on the counter.
en: Over on the counter.
ja: カウンターの上。

key: Hurry, while it's still warm.
en: Hurry, while it's still warm.
ja: 早く、冷めないうちに。

key: MOTHER: Sigmund, we have work to do.
en: MOTHER: Sigmund, we have work to do.
ja: 母: シグムンド、こっちはやることがあるの。

key: Please do your homework in your own room.
en: Please do your homework in your own room.
ja: 宿題は自分の部屋でやってちょうだい。

key: MOTHER: Please bring your sister her medicine.
en: MOTHER: Please bring your sister her medicine.
ja: 母: お姉ちゃんにお薬を持っていって。

key: It's over on the counter.
en: It's over on the counter.
ja: カウンターの上にあるから。

key: I recognize you might have some reservations about all of this, but you and I are not medical professionals.
en: I recognize you might have some reservations about all of this, but you and I are not medical professionals.
ja: これについてあなたが思うところがあるのはわかってる。でも、あなたも私も医療の専門家じゃないでしょ。

key: The doctor has assured me that a regular course of prescriptions is the best way to advance her towards recovery.
en: The doctor has assured me that a regular course of prescriptions is the best way to advance her towards recovery.
ja: お医者様は、決められた通りに薬を飲み続けるのが、回復への一番の近道だと保証してくれた。

key: All we can do is trust in him.
en: All we can do is trust in him.
ja: 私たちにできるのは、先生を信じることだけ。

key: If you understand, then please bring her her medicine.
en: If you understand, then please bring her her medicine.
ja: わかったなら、お薬を持っていってあげて。

key: Now, before it gets too late.
en: Now, before it gets too late.
ja: 遅くならないうちに、早く。

key: MOTHER: How has your new school been?
en: MOTHER: How has your new school been?
ja: 母: 新しい学校はどう?

key: Have you gotten used to everything?
en: Have you gotten used to everything?
ja: もう慣れた?

key: MOTHER: Your classes are going well?
en: MOTHER: Your classes are going well?
ja: 母: 授業はうまくいってる?

key: We covered everything last year at my old school anyway.
en: We covered everything last year at my old school anyway.
ja: 前の学校で、もう去年全部やったところだけど。

key: MOTHER: I'm sure a refresher can't hurt.
en: MOTHER: I'm sure a refresher can't hurt.
ja: 母: 復習になって悪いことはないでしょ。

key: Make sure to maintain effective studying habits now!
en: Make sure to maintain effective studying habits now!
ja: ちゃんとした勉強の習慣を保つのよ!

key: They'll serve you well later on.
en: They'll serve you well later on.
ja: 将来きっと役に立つから。

key: MOTHER: Don't disturb your sister either.
en: MOTHER: Don't disturb your sister either.
ja: 母: お姉ちゃんの邪魔もしないでね。

key: She's at a fragile point in her life.
en: She's at a fragile point in her life.
ja: 今はとても不安定な時期なんだから。

key: FATHER: Don't ignore your mother, boy.
en: FATHER: Don't ignore your mother, boy.
ja: 父: 母さんを無視するな、坊主。

key: FATHER: Was your mother's request unclear, or is this insubordination?
en: FATHER: Was your mother's request unclear, or is this insubordination?
ja: 父: 母さんの頼みがわかりにくかったのか、それとも反抗か?

key: You are to deliver tea to your sister.
en: You are to deliver tea to your sister.
ja: お前は姉にお茶を届けるんだ。

key: Now.
en: Now.
ja: 今すぐに。

key: FATHER: What do you want, boy?
en: FATHER: What do you want, boy?
ja: 父: 何の用だ、坊主。

key: You have work to do, do you not?
en: You have work to do, do you not?
ja: やることがあるだろう?

key: Stop lollygagging and get it done.
en: Stop lollygagging and get it done.
ja: だらだらしてないで、さっさと片付けろ。

key: MOTHER: Sigmund?
en: MOTHER: Sigmund?
ja: 母: シグムンド?

key: That's not for you.
en: That's not for you.
ja: それはあなたのものじゃないの。

key: Come here.
en: Come here.
ja: こっちへ来なさい。

key: Acquired Tea!
en: Acquired Tea!
ja: お茶を手に入れた!

key: Acquired Medicine!
en: Acquired Medicine!
ja: お薬を手に入れた!

key: MOTHER: Sigmund, where are you going?
en: MOTHER: Sigmund, where are you going?
ja: 母: シグムンド、どこへ行くの?

key: Weren't you listening?
en: Weren't you listening?
ja: 聞いてなかったの?

key: MOTHER: That's your father's office, dear.
en: MOTHER: That's your father's office, dear.
ja: 母: そこはお父さんの書斎よ。

key: Do your homework in your own room.
en: Do your homework in your own room.
ja: 宿題は自分の部屋でやりなさい。

key: SIGMUND: I'd better not go back in there...
en: SIGMUND: I'd better not go back in there...
ja: シグムンド: あそこにはもう戻らない方がいいな……

key: MOTHER: Sigmund, don't bother your sister.
en: MOTHER: Sigmund, don't bother your sister.
ja: 母: シグムンド、お姉ちゃんの邪魔をしないで。

key: Come, talk to us.
en: Come, talk to us.
ja: こっちへ来て、話しましょう。

key: MOTHER: Sigmund, don't forget the tea.
en: MOTHER: Sigmund, don't forget the tea.
ja: 母: シグムンド、お茶を忘れないで。

key: MOTHER: Now, don't you have homework to do?
en: MOTHER: Now, don't you have homework to do?
ja: 母: それより、宿題があるんじゃない?

key: Best you get to your room and get started.
en: Best you get to your room and get started.
ja: 部屋に戻って始めた方がいいわ。

key: And I don't want to see you reading any of those ridiculous books until you're done!
en: And I don't want to see you reading any of those ridiculous books until you're done!
ja: 終わるまで、あのくだらない本を読んでるところなんて見たくないからね!

key: "Fiction" is just senseless drivel to clutter children's heads!
en: "Fiction" is just senseless drivel to clutter children's heads!
ja: 「フィクション」なんて、子供の頭をごちゃごちゃにするだけの、無意味な戯言よ!

key: You'll thank me later in life for keeping you on the straight and narrow.
en: You'll thank me later in life for keeping you on the straight and narrow.
ja: まっすぐな道を歩ませてくれたこと、いつか感謝するようになるから。

key: MOTHER: Did you not hear me?
en: MOTHER: Did you not hear me?
ja: 母: 聞こえなかったの?

key: Leave your sister alone and go do your homework right this instant!
en: Leave your sister alone and go do your homework right this instant!
ja: お姉ちゃんに構わないで、今すぐ宿題をしに行きなさい!

key: The pills?
en: The pills?
ja: 薬?

key: SIGMUND: ...
en: SIGMUND: ...
ja: シグムンド: ……

key: MOTHER: Don't even think about it, Sigmund.
en: MOTHER: Don't even think about it, Sigmund.
ja: 母: 考えることすら許さないわよ、シグムンド。

key: MOTHER: Go on.
en: MOTHER: Go on.
ja: 母: 行きなさい。

key: SIGMUND: How is she?
en: SIGMUND: How is she?
ja: シグムンド: お姉ちゃんの調子は?

key: MOTHER: Sleeping.
en: MOTHER: Sleeping.
ja: 母: 眠ってる。

key: And fine.
en: And fine.
ja: それだけよ。

key: From now on, her wellbeing is none of your concern.
en: From now on, her wellbeing is none of your concern.
ja: これからは、あの子の体調はあなたが気にすることじゃないの。

key: Focus on your studies.
en: Focus on your studies.
ja: 勉強に集中しなさい。

key: MOTHER: Go.
en: MOTHER: Go.
ja: 母: 行きなさい。

key: MOTHER: Sigmund.
en: MOTHER: Sigmund.
ja: 母: シグムンド。

key: MOTHER: You will stay out of there.
en: MOTHER: You will stay out of there.
ja: 母: あそこには近づかないで。

key: Are we clear?
en: Are we clear?
ja: わかった?

key: SIGMUND: Lizzy.
en: SIGMUND: Lizzy.
ja: シグムンド: リジー。

key: Mother said to drink this to feel better.
en: Mother said to drink this to feel better.
ja: これを飲めば楽になるって、母さんが。

key: ELIZABETH: Of course she said that-- she's not the one who has to drink it!
en: ELIZABETH: Of course she said that-- she's not the one who has to drink it!
ja: エリザベス: そりゃそう言うでしょうよ――飲まされるのはママじゃないんだから!

key: Ugh... This morning's tea tasted like a Machoke's backside.
en: Ugh... This morning's tea tasted like a Machoke's backside.
ja: うぇ……今朝のお茶、ゴーリキーのお尻みたいな味だった。

key: Hey, how was your first day of school?
en: Hey, how was your first day of school?
ja: ねえ、学校の初日どうだった?

key: Did you make any friends?
en: Did you make any friends?
ja: 友達できた?

key: SIGMUND: I'm... not there to make friends.
en: SIGMUND: I'm... not there to make friends.
ja: シグムンド: 僕は……友達を作りに行ってるわけじゃないよ。

key: I'm there to learn.
en: I'm there to learn.
ja: 学びに行ってるんだ。

key: ELIZABETH: Okay, but do both!
en: ELIZABETH: Okay, but do both!
ja: エリザベス: オッケー、でも両方やりなよ!

key: Oh goodness, what did they DO to this tea?
en: Oh goodness, what did they DO to this tea?
ja: もう、このお茶に一体何したのよ?

key: SIGMUND: Machoke's backside again?
en: SIGMUND: Machoke's backside again?
ja: シグムンド: またゴーリキーのお尻?

key: ELIZABETH: More like a Bidoof's butthole!
en: ELIZABETH: More like a Bidoof's butthole!
ja: エリザベス: むしろビッパのケツの穴って感じ!

key: SIGMUND: Snrrk--
en: SIGMUND: Snrrk--
ja: シグムンド: ぶふっ――

key: ELIZABETH: Hey, do you wanna just... dump this into one of the potted plants for me?
en: ELIZABETH: Hey, do you wanna just... dump this into one of the potted plants for me?
ja: エリザベス: ねえ、その……これ、鉢植えのどれかに捨てちゃってくれない?

key: Save me, Sigmund!
en: Save me, Sigmund!
ja: 助けて、シグムンド!

key: You're the only one who can!
en: You're the only one who can!
ja: あなたにしかできないの!

key: SIGMUND: Of course.
en: SIGMUND: Of course.
ja: シグムンド: もちろん。

key: ELIZABETH: Just dump that disgusting tea into any of the plants in here.
en: ELIZABETH: Just dump that disgusting tea into any of the plants in here.
ja: エリザベス: この気持ち悪いお茶、そのへんの植木にでも捨てちゃって。

key: It can't be good for them, but we all have to make sacrifices...
en: It can't be good for them, but we all have to make sacrifices...
ja: 植物にはよくないだろうけど、誰かが犠牲にならなきゃね……

key: ELIZABETH: Even if you make a few friends at school, mom and dad don't necessarily have to know!
en: ELIZABETH: Even if you make a few friends at school, mom and dad don't necessarily have to know!
ja: エリザベス: 学校で友達が何人かできても、ママとパパに知られる必要はないんだからね!

key: Just think about it.
en: Just think about it.
ja: 考えといて。

key: ELIZABETH: So...
en: ELIZABETH: So...
ja: エリザベス: それで……

key: More pills, huh.
en: More pills, huh.
ja: また薬か。

key: Hey, Siggy?
en: Hey, Siggy?
ja: ねえ、シギー?

key: Do you really think there's something wrong with me?
en: Do you really think there's something wrong with me?
ja: 本当に、私のどこかおかしいと思う?

key: ELIZABETH: The doctor says so, so I guess there must be...
en: ELIZABETH: The doctor says so, so I guess there must be...
ja: エリザベス: お医者様がそう言うんだから、きっとそうなんでしょうね……

key: I don't get it.
en: I don't get it.
ja: よく わかりません

key: ELIZABETH: ...
en: ELIZABETH: ...
ja: エリザベス: ……

key: I don't understand either.
en: I don't understand either.
ja: 私にもわからない。

key: So why...
en: So why...
ja: だから、どうして……

key: Why all of this?
en: Why all of this?
ja: どうしてこんなことに?

key: I guess you still have homework to do though, huh.
en: I guess you still have homework to do though, huh.
ja: まあ、あなたはまだ宿題があるんだよね。

key: You know, I don't wanna be the person who's like "I have it worse" all the time, but--
en: You know, I don't wanna be the person who's like "I have it worse" all the time, but--
ja: 「私の方が大変」ばっかり言う人にはなりたくないんだけど――

key: I think I'd gladly accept the homework if it meant I could at least go to school and see people again.
en: I think I'd gladly accept the homework if it meant I could at least go to school and see people again.
ja: 学校に行って人に会えるなら、宿題くらい喜んで引き受けるのに。

key: Being cooped up here all the time is going to drive me crazy.
en: Being cooped up here all the time is going to drive me crazy.
ja: ずっとここに閉じ込められてたら、おかしくなっちゃう。

key: But they say it's what's best...
en: But they say it's what's best...
ja: でも、それが一番いいって言うから……

key: I dunno, Siggy.
en: I dunno, Siggy.
ja: わかんないよ、シギー。

key: I just don't know...
en: I just don't know...
ja: 本当に、わかんない……

key: ELIZABETH: Maybe there is something wrong with me.
en: ELIZABETH: Maybe there is something wrong with me.
ja: エリザベス: もしかしたら、私のどこかおかしいのかもね。

key: Anyone else should be able to be happy like this, right?
en: Anyone else should be able to be happy like this, right?
ja: 他の人なら、こんな状況でも幸せでいられるはずだもんね?

key: SIGMUND: Lizzy, mom says you have to take your medicine.
en: SIGMUND: Lizzy, mom says you have to take your medicine.
ja: シグムンド: リジー、お薬を飲まなきゃって、母さんが。

key: SIGMUND: ...Lizzy?
en: SIGMUND: ...Lizzy?
ja: シグムンド: ……リジー?

key: ELIZABETH: Siggy...
en: ELIZABETH: Siggy...
ja: エリザベス: シギー……

key: Siggy, I don't like these...
en: Siggy, I don't like these...
ja: シギー、これ嫌い……

key: SIGMUND: I'm sorry...?
en: SIGMUND: I'm sorry...?
ja: シグムンド: ごめん……?

key: The pills, you mean?
en: The pills, you mean?
ja: 薬のこと?

key: LIZZY: I don't--
en: LIZZY: I don't--
ja: リジー: 私、その――

key: I don't feel like myself,
en: I don't feel like myself,
ja: 自分じゃないみたいな感じがするの、

key: When I'm on them...
en: When I'm on them...
ja: これを飲んでると……

key: And just when I start to again,
en: And just when I start to again,
ja: やっと戻ってきた気がしても、

key: It's time for the next one...
en: It's time for the next one...
ja: また次の分の時間になっちゃう……

key: Siggy--
en: Siggy--
ja: シギー――

key: Siggy, do I have to?
en: Siggy, do I have to?
ja: シギー、飲まなきゃだめ?

key: SIGMUND: The doctor said that this is the best way for you to get better...
en: SIGMUND: The doctor said that this is the best way for you to get better...
ja: シグムンド: お医者様が、これが一番よくなる方法だって言ってた……

key: SIGMUND: If you really don't feel good taking them, I don't think you should.
en: SIGMUND: If you really don't feel good taking them, I don't think you should.
ja: シグムンド: 飲んで本当に辛いなら、無理して飲まなくていいと思う。

key: Surely we can talk to the doctor.
en: Surely we can talk to the doctor.
ja: お医者様に相談してみようよ。

key: ELIZABETH: Just--
en: ELIZABETH: Just--
ja: エリザベス: ただ――

key: Just leave it there.
en: Just leave it there.
ja: そこに置いといて。

key: I'm tired...
en: I'm tired...
ja: 疲れた……

key: SIGMUND: Sure.
en: SIGMUND: Sure.
ja: シグムンド: うん。

key: If you need anything, just let me know.
en: If you need anything, just let me know.
ja: 何かあったら言ってね。

key: ELIZABETH: Oh, hi, Siggy...
en: ELIZABETH: Oh, hi, Siggy...
ja: エリザベス: あ、シギー……

key: Did you see my friend?
en: Did you see my friend?
ja: 私の友達、見た?

key: She came all the way here from my old school to visit me.
en: She came all the way here from my old school to visit me.
ja: 前の学校からわざわざ会いに来てくれたの。

key: Isn't that crazy?
en: Isn't that crazy?
ja: すごくない?

key: I think maybe I worried her though--
en: I think maybe I worried her though--
ja: でも心配させちゃったかも――

key: I can't, really...
en: I can't, really...
ja: 本当に、無理で……

key: Because I'm not like-- me,
en: Because I'm not like-- me,
ja: だって、私は――私じゃないから、

key: You know?
en: You know?
ja: わかる?

key: I don't know...
en: I don't know...
ja: わかんない……

key: Maybe I'm getting used to it?
en: Maybe I'm getting used to it?
ja: 慣れてきてるのかな?

key: Maybe it's like this...
en: Maybe it's like this...
ja: こんな感じなのかな……

key: She said it'll be okay.
en: She said it'll be okay.
ja: 大丈夫だよって言ってくれた。

key: She said she saw a shooting star last night, and, like, wished that I would be okay.
en: She said she saw a shooting star last night, and, like, wished that I would be okay.
ja: 昨日の夜流れ星を見て、私が元気になるようにって願ったんだって。

key: Isn't that so nice of her?
en: Isn't that so nice of her?
ja: 優しいよね?

key: But there's something I've always wondered...
en: But there's something I've always wondered...
ja: でも、ずっと気になってたことがあって……

key: Do you think shooting stars are like Santa?
en: Do you think shooting stars are like Santa?
ja: 流れ星ってサンタさんみたいなものだと思う?

key: Like can they cover the whole world in one night--
en: Like can they cover the whole world in one night--
ja: ほら、一晩で世界中を回れちゃうみたいな――

key: If more than one person wishes on it, can it grant every wish?
en: If more than one person wishes on it, can it grant every wish?
ja: 一つの流れ星に何人もお願いしたら、全部かなえてくれるのかな?

key: Or does it only get one?
en: Or does it only get one?
ja: それとも一つだけ?

key: I've always wondered that...
en: I've always wondered that...
ja: ずっと気になってた……

key: I hope that, if it's like a first come, first served-- kind of thing...
en: I hope that, if it's like a first come, first served-- kind of thing...

en: MOTHER: I just don't understand what you were thinking!
ja: 母: 一体何を考えていたのか、さっぱりわからないわ!

key: Just look at your new dress!
en: Just look at your new dress!
ja: 新しいドレスを見なさい!

key: Do you see all these grass stains?
en: Do you see all these grass stains?
ja: この草のシミ全部見える?

key: Do you have any idea how long it's going to take me to get them out?!
en: Do you have any idea how long it's going to take me to get them out?!
ja: これを落とすのにどれだけ時間がかかると思ってるの?!

key: ELIZABETH: I'm sorry.
en: ELIZABETH: I'm sorry.
ja: エリザベス: ごめんなさい。

key: MOTHER: "Sorry" will not get the stains out!
en: MOTHER: "Sorry" will not get the stains out!
ja: 母: 「ごめんなさい」でシミが取れるわけじゃないのよ!

key: We have enough trouble with you as is.
en: We have enough trouble with you as is.
ja: あなたのことだけでも、もう十分に手を焼いてるのよ。

key: Do you have any idea what kind of pressure all of your medical fees have put onto your father's finances?
en: Do you have any idea what kind of pressure all of your medical fees have put onto your father's finances?
ja: あなたの医療費が、お父さんの財政にどれだけの負担をかけているかわかってるの?

key: ELIZABETH: I said I'm sorry...
en: ELIZABETH: I said I'm sorry...
ja: エリザベス: ごめんなさいって言ったでしょ……

key: MOTHER: You can say so all you want, but the words don't solve the problems.
en: MOTHER: You can say so all you want, but the words don't solve the problems.
ja: 母: いくら言っても、言葉じゃ問題は解決しないのよ。

key: What is going on with you?
en: What is going on with you?
ja: 一体どうしちゃったの?

key: How can we help you?!
en: How can we help you?!
ja: どうすればあなたの力になれるの?!

key: Have we done something to you to make you want to get back at us like this?
en: Have we done something to you to make you want to get back at us like this?
ja: 私たちがあなたに何かして、それでこんな仕返しをしたくなったの?

key: MOTHER: Don't you have anything to say for yourself?
en: MOTHER: Don't you have anything to say for yourself?
ja: 母: 自分から何か言うことはないの?

key: ELIZABETH: I'm-- sorry...
en: ELIZABETH: I'm-- sorry...
ja: エリザベス: ごめん――なさい……

key: MOTHER: Heavenly father above, you do try me in these times...
en: MOTHER: Heavenly father above, you do try me in these times...
ja: 母: 神様、こんなときにまで私を試すのですね……

key: And you, Sigmund!
en: And you, Sigmund!
ja: それと、あなた、シグムンド!

key: You should have known better than to let her run off like that!
en: You should have known better than to let her run off like that!
ja: あの子をあんなふうに走らせるなんて、もっとわかっているべきでしょう!

key: What were you even doing there?
en: What were you even doing there?
ja: そもそもあんな所で何をしていたの?

key: FATHER: Boys will be boys, my dear.
en: FATHER: Boys will be boys, my dear.
ja: 父: 男の子はそういうものだよ、あなた。

key: But as men, we have a responsibility to look out for those around us.
en: But as men, we have a responsibility to look out for those around us.
ja: だが男として、周りの者を気にかける責任がある。

key: I'm extremely disappointed in you, boy.
en: I'm extremely disappointed in you, boy.
ja: お前にはひどく失望したぞ。

key: MOTHER: And there's still the matter of the Pokémon to settle!
en: MOTHER: And there's still the matter of the Pokémon to settle!
ja: 母: それに、まだポケモンのことも片付いてないわ!

key: Honestly, what did you think would happen?
en: Honestly, what did you think would happen?
ja: 本当に、どうなると思ってたの?

key: You'd just bring this rat home and everyone would be okay feeding it out of our own pockets?
en: You'd just bring this rat home and everyone would be okay feeding it out of our own pockets?
ja: こんなネズミを家に連れて帰って、うちのお金で餌をやることをみんなが平気だと思うなんて?

key: I don't think you two understand that money doesn't grow on trees--
en: I don't think you two understand that money doesn't grow on trees--
ja: あなたたち二人とも、お金が木になるわけじゃないってわかってないみたいね――

key: And for goodness' sake, we can barely take care of you two!
en: And for goodness' sake, we can barely take care of you two!
ja: それに、そもそもあなたたち二人の面倒を見るだけで手一杯なのよ!

key: FATHER: Sigmund may keep it as long as he maintains his grades.
en: FATHER: Sigmund may keep it as long as he maintains his grades.
ja: 父: シグムンドが成績を維持する限り、飼ってもいい。

key: MOTHER: But--
en: MOTHER: But--
ja: 母: でも――

key: FATHER: I've made my decision, and you will not overrule it.
en: FATHER: I've made my decision, and you will not overrule it.
ja: 父: 私はもう決めた。お前がそれを覆すことはない。

key: There are worse tools to be kept, and perhaps it can be a valuable and motivating incentive.
en: There are worse tools to be kept, and perhaps it can be a valuable and motivating incentive.
ja: もっと悪い代物を飼うこともあるだろうし、それに励みになる動機付けにもなるだろう。

key: If your grades slip in even the slightest, however, you will be releasing it at once.
en: If your grades slip in even the slightest, however, you will be releasing it at once.
ja: だが成績が少しでも下がったら、その時はすぐに逃がしてもらうぞ。

key: FATHER: ...Am I understood?
en: FATHER: ...Am I understood?
ja: 父: ……わかったな?

key: MOTHER: ...Yes, dear.
en: MOTHER: ...Yes, dear.
ja: 母: ……はい、あなた。

key: FATHER: Figure out the details.
en: FATHER: Figure out the details.
ja: 父: 詳しいことは自分たちで決めなさい。

key: This has cost too much time already.
en: This has cost too much time already.
ja: もう十分に時間を無駄にした。

key: DOCTOR: Since the mixed doses haven't proven effective, we can begin a more aggressive solution.
en: DOCTOR: Since the mixed doses haven't proven effective, we can begin a more aggressive solution.
ja: ドクター: 混合投与では効果が見られなかったので、もっと積極的な治療を始めましょう。

key: Three times daily, just as I explained.
en: Three times daily, just as I explained.
ja: 説明した通り、一日三回です。

key: Please read the side-effects and precautions thoroughly; they can be quite intense.
en: Please read the side-effects and precautions thoroughly; they can be quite intense.
ja: 副作用と注意事項をよく読んでください。かなり強く出ることがありますので。

key: MOTHER: Whatever will help her...
en: MOTHER: Whatever will help her...
ja: 母: あの子のためになることなら何でも……

key: We'll do anything for our little Elizabeth, of course...
en: We'll do anything for our little Elizabeth, of course...
ja: もちろん、私たちの大切なエリザベスのためなら何でもしますとも……

key: DOCTOR: Very good.
en: DOCTOR: Very good.
ja: ドクター: 結構です。

key: Any questions or complications, just call.
en: Any questions or complications, just call.
ja: 何か質問や不都合がありましたら、いつでもご連絡ください。

key: Then I'll be on my way.
en: Then I'll be on my way.
ja: では、失礼いたします。

key: DOCTOR: Oh, hello there.
en: DOCTOR: Oh, hello there.
ja: ドクター: おや、こんにちは。

key: You must be Sigmund.
en: You must be Sigmund.
ja: 君がシグムンドだね。

key: SIGMUND: Hello...
en: SIGMUND: Hello...
ja: シグムンド: こんにちは……

key: DOCTOR: No need to be shy.
en: DOCTOR: No need to be shy.
ja: ドクター: 恥ずかしがらなくていいよ。

key: I'm your sister's new doctor.
en: I'm your sister's new doctor.
ja: 私は君のお姉さんの新しい担当医だ。

key: We're going to have her right as rain in no time, so don't you worry about a thing.
en: We're going to have her right as rain in no time, so don't you worry about a thing.
ja: すぐによくしてあげるから、何も心配しなくていい。

key: SIGMUND: What, exactly, is wrong with her?
en: SIGMUND: What, exactly, is wrong with her?
ja: シグムンド: 姉は、実際のところ何が悪いんですか?

key: DOCTOR: Ah...
en: DOCTOR: Ah...
ja: ドクター: ああ……

key: To put it plainly, she's just...
en: To put it plainly, she's just...
ja: 簡単に言うと、彼女はただ……

key: She's very sad.
en: She's very sad.
ja: とても悲しんでいるんだ。

key: And we want to make sure she'll feel better.
en: And we want to make sure she'll feel better.
ja: だから、良くなるように私たちがしっかり見ていく。

key: SIGMUND: That's what the last one said.
en: SIGMUND: That's what the last one said.
ja: シグムンド: 前の先生も同じことを言ってました。

key: DOCTOR: ...Is it?
en: DOCTOR: ...Is it?
ja: ドクター: ……そうかい?

key: Well, medicine is an imperfect science after all-- and even if something we do doesn't entirely work, it's still one step closer to figuring out what does.
en: Well, medicine is an imperfect science after all-- and even if something we do doesn't entirely work, it's still one step closer to figuring out what does.
ja: まあ、医学は完璧な科学ではないからね――たとえうまくいかないことがあっても、それも何が効くかを見つけるための一歩なんだよ。

key: We'll get to the bottom of it.
en: We'll get to the bottom of it.
ja: 必ず突き止めてみせるよ。

key: Now, I must be on my way.
en: Now, I must be on my way.
ja: さて、そろそろ失礼するよ。

key: MOTHER: I've got to get dinner ready before your father comes home.
en: MOTHER: I've got to get dinner ready before your father comes home.
ja: 母: お父さんが帰ってくる前に夕飯の支度をしないと。

key: Why don't you go ahead and get started on your homework?
en: Why don't you go ahead and get started on your homework?
ja: あなたは先に宿題を始めておいたらどう?

key: MOTHER: Welcome home, Sigmund.
en: MOTHER: Welcome home, Sigmund.
ja: 母: おかえりなさい、シグムンド。

key: Be a dear and bring your sister her pills again, won't you?
en: Be a dear and bring your sister her pills again, won't you?
ja: いい子だから、またお姉ちゃんに薬を持っていってあげて。

key: Welcome home.
en: Welcome home.
ja: おかえりなさい。

key: Your sister's had a tiring day.
en: Your sister's had a tiring day.
ja: お姉ちゃんは今日は疲れた一日だったの。

key: Would you bring her her pills again?
en: Would you bring her her pills again?
ja: また薬を持っていってあげてくれる?

key: FATHER: I am TIRED of your excuses, doctor!
en: FATHER: I am TIRED of your excuses, doctor!
ja: 父: ドクター、お前の言い訳にはもううんざりだ!

key: SIGMUND: That sounded like it came from Dad's office...
en: SIGMUND: That sounded like it came from Dad's office...
ja: シグムンド: 今の、父さんの書斎からだったような……

key: MOTHER: Please, it was just an accident...
en: MOTHER: Please, it was just an accident...
ja: 母: お願い、ただの事故だったの……

key: FATHER: If it were an accident, you should have corrected it already!
en: FATHER: If it were an accident, you should have corrected it already!
ja: 父: 事故だと言うなら、とっくに直しておくべきだっただろう!

key: How hard is it to have dinner on the table at the same time each day?
en: How hard is it to have dinner on the table at the same time each day?
ja: 毎日同じ時間に夕食をテーブルに出す、それがそんなに難しいことか?

key: I do not have the same luxuries I provide for you-- to snack like a pig all day wherever it suits my fancy.
en: I do not have the same luxuries I provide for you-- to snack like a pig all day wherever it suits my fancy.
ja: 私はお前に与えているようなぜいたく――気ままに一日中豚のように間食するようなぜいたくは許されていないんだ。

key: I have times at which I must eat.
en: I have times at which I must eat.
ja: 私には食事をとるべき時間というものがある。

key: MOTHER: I know, but it just burned; I had to run out to get more--
en: MOTHER: I know, but it just burned; I had to run out to get more--
ja: 母: わかってるわ、でも焦げてしまって、買いに走らなきゃいけなくて――

key: FATHER: Yes, you've said that three times now.
en: FATHER: Yes, you've said that three times now.
ja: 父: ああ、それはもう三回目だぞ。

key: You have one job.
en: You have one job.
ja: お前の仕事はひとつしかない。

key: You maintain the household.
en: You maintain the household.
ja: 家庭を切り盛りすることだ。

key: You should never have allowed yourself to be in a position where we run out of what we need.
en: You should never have allowed yourself to be in a position where we run out of what we need.
ja: 必要な物が足りなくなるような事態を、そもそも許すべきではなかった。

key: It is carelessness exemplified.
en: It is carelessness exemplified.
ja: これは不注意の典型だ。

key: How do you expect to be a role model to Elizabeth that way?
en: How do you expect to be a role model to Elizabeth that way?
ja: それでどうやってエリザベスの手本になるつもりだ?

key: How will she know how to be a good wife in the future herself?
en: How will she know how to be a good wife in the future herself?
ja: どうやって将来、良い妻になる方法をあの子が学べる?

key: You are lucky you only have me to deal with after a mistake.
en: You are lucky you only have me to deal with after a mistake.
ja: 間違いを犯した後、私だけを相手にすればいいのだから、お前は幸運なんだぞ。

key: If I make one slip up, I can lose a multi-thousand dollar settlement.
en: If I make one slip up, I can lose a multi-thousand dollar settlement.
ja: 私が一度でも失敗すれば、何千ドルもの示談金を失いかねない。

key: If you make one mistake, you know nothing will happen.
en: If you make one mistake, you know nothing will happen.
ja: お前が一度失敗しても、何も起きないだろう。

key: I will suffer, and I will forgive you every time,
en: I will suffer, and I will forgive you every time,
ja: 私が苦しみ、毎回お前を許す。

key: Because that's the kind of man I am.
en: Because that's the kind of man I am.
ja: それが私という男だからだ。

key: Still, I truly wish you would stop bringing others down just because of your negligent incompetence.
en: Still, I truly wish you would stop bringing others down just because of your negligent incompetence.
ja: だがそれでも、お前の怠慢な無能さのせいで周りを引きずり下ろすのはやめてほしいものだ。

key: MOTHER: Yes, of course...
en: MOTHER: Yes, of course...
ja: 母: ええ、もちろん……

key: FATHER: You are doing your best, I should remind myself.
en: FATHER: You are doing your best, I should remind myself.
ja: 父: お前は最善を尽くしているのだと、自分に言い聞かせなければな。

key: Mistakes are to be expected, especially from you.
en: Mistakes are to be expected, especially from you.
ja: 間違いは仕方ない、特にお前の場合は。

key: It is okay.
en: It is okay.
ja: 大丈夫だ。

key: But go ahead and get something started already, will you?
en: But go ahead and get something started already, will you?
ja: だがもう何か作り始めてくれないか?

key: I'm famished here.
en: I'm famished here.
ja: 腹が減っているんだ。

key: I didn't hear anything.
en: I didn't hear anything.
ja: 何も聞こえなかった。

key: Everything is fine.
en: Everything is fine.
ja: 何も問題ない。

key: I just need to figure out how to help Lizzy...
en: I just need to figure out how to help Lizzy...
ja: リジーを助ける方法を見つけないと……

key: SIGMUND: This book I got from the library mentions electric therapy theory.
en: SIGMUND: This book I got from the library mentions electric therapy theory.
ja: シグムンド: 図書館で借りたこの本、電気療法の理論について書いてある。

key: Maybe I'll get started a bit and just say it's for my homework...
en: Maybe I'll get started a bit and just say it's for my homework...
ja: 少しやってみて、宿題のためだって言えばいいか……

key: ELIZABETH: Siggy...?
en: ELIZABETH: Siggy...?
ja: エリザベス: シギー……?

key: ELIZABETH: Psst, Siggy!
en: ELIZABETH: Psst, Siggy!
ja: エリザベス: ねえ、シギー!

key: MOTHER: Welcome home.
en: MOTHER: Welcome home.
ja: 母: おかえりなさい。

key: Go straight to your room today again as well.
en: Go straight to your room today again as well.
ja: 今日もまっすぐ部屋に行きなさい。

key: We will not be having any more incidents.
en: We will not be having any more incidents.
ja: もうこれ以上騒ぎは起こさせないから。

key: MOTHER: The doctor kept me too long...
en: MOTHER: The doctor kept me too long...
ja: 母: お医者様に長く引き止められてしまって……

key: I should've gotten started already.
en: I should've gotten started already.
ja: もっと早く始めておけばよかった。

key: What can I make quickly?
en: What can I make quickly?
ja: 何か手早く作れるものは……

key: I don't want him to be cross with me...
en: I don't want him to be cross with me...
ja: あの人に不機嫌になってほしくないの……

key: Pi-pi!
en: Pi-pi!
ja: ピーピ!

key: ???: Oh, excuse me.
en: ???: Oh, excuse me.
ja: ???: おっと、失礼。

key: CHIMECHO: Chiii!
en: CHIMECHO: Chiii!
ja: チリーン: チィー!

key: FATHER: Doctor, you were hired to make her better.
en: FATHER: Doctor, you were hired to make her better.
ja: 父: ドクター、あなたは彼女を治すために雇われているんですよ。

key: She is getting worse.
en: She is getting worse.
ja: なのに悪くなっている。

key: DOCTOR: Some degree of side effects are inescapable, of course...
en: DOCTOR: Some degree of side effects are inescapable, of course...
ja: ドクター: ある程度の副作用は避けられないものです、もちろん……

key: But I assure you, we are doing and will continue to do and try everything possible for the sake of your daughter's wellbeing.
en: But I assure you, we are doing and will continue to do and try everything possible for the sake of your daughter's wellbeing.
ja: しかしお約束します。私たちは娘さんの幸福のために、あらゆる手を尽くしていますし、これからも尽くし続けます。

key: However...
en: However...
ja: ただ……

key: From talking to her, I get the sense that rather than direct treatment, a more positive and healthy environment might go a long way for her...
en: From talking to her, I get the sense that rather than direct treatment, a more positive and healthy environment might go a long way for her...
ja: 彼女と話していて感じるのですが、直接的な治療よりも、もっと前向きで健全な環境の方が、彼女には効果があるのではないかと……

key: FATHER: We've heard that one before.
en: FATHER: We've heard that one before.
ja: 父: その話は前にも聞いた。

key: That's why we already moved all the way out here to bumfuck nowhere--
en: That's why we already moved all the way out here to bumfuck nowhere--
ja: だからこそ、わざわざこんなへんぴな場所まで越してきたんだ――

key: Exactly where do you want us to go? Where is going to be "healthy" enough?
en: Exactly where do you want us to go? Where is going to be "healthy" enough?
ja: 一体どこへ行けばいいと言うんだ? どこまで行けば「健全」なんだ?

key: DOCTOR: N-no, sir. I'm not referring to the local climate.
en: DOCTOR: N-no, sir. I'm not referring to the local climate.
ja: ドクター: い、いえ、違います。地元の気候の話ではありません。

key: I mean her home environment.
en: I mean her home environment.
ja: 家庭環境の話です。

key: FATHER: What are you saying, doctor?
en: FATHER: What are you saying, doctor?
ja: 父: 何が言いたいんだ、ドクター?

key: Do you mean to imply that this is somehow our fault?
en: Do you mean to imply that this is somehow our fault?
ja: これが私たちのせいだとでも言うつもりか?

key: What lies has she been telling you?
en: What lies has she been telling you?
ja: あの子はあなたにどんなうそをついたんだ?

key: DOCTOR: Without intending to place blame, sir,
en: DOCTOR: Without intending to place blame, sir,
ja: ドクター: 責めるつもりはありません、ですが、

key: I am suggesting that a little more positive reinforcement and care might be necessary to improve her affect regardless of our intervention.
en: I am suggesting that a little more positive reinforcement and care might be necessary to improve her affect regardless of our intervention.
ja: 私たちの治療とは別に、もう少し前向きな支えと気遣いがあれば、彼女の気分の改善に役立つのではないかと申し上げているのです。

key: FATHER: Enough.
en: FATHER: Enough.
ja: 父: もういい。

key: I am not going to sit here and let you tell ME how to behave in the comfort of my own-- already uprooted-- home!
en: I am not going to sit here and let you tell ME how to behave in the comfort of my own-- already uprooted-- home!
ja: 自分の家で――ただでさえ根こそぎ移り住んだこの家で――どう振る舞うべきかお前に教えられる筋合いはない!

key: You have been hired to fix her, doctor.
en: You have been hired to fix her, doctor.
ja: お前はあの子を治すために雇われているんだ、ドクター。

key: Not me.
en: Not me.
ja: 私ではない。

key: If you want to retain your job, I suggest you quit making excuses and deflecting blame, and start coming up with a solution.
en: If you want to retain your job, I suggest you quit making excuses and deflecting blame, and start coming up with a solution.
ja: 仕事を続けたいなら、言い訳や責任転嫁はやめて、解決策を出すことだな。

key: Drugs, therapy, electroconvulsive treatment-- I don't care what it is!
en: Drugs, therapy, electroconvulsive treatment-- I don't care what it is!
ja: 薬でも療法でも電気けいれん療法でも――何だっていい!

key: If it will help my daughter, get it done.
en: If it will help my daughter, get it done.
ja: 娘の助けになるなら、やってくれ。

key: DOCTOR: S-sir, ECT has generally been outlawed due to ethical concerns--
en: DOCTOR: S-sir, ECT has generally been outlawed due to ethical concerns--
ja: ドクター: せ、先生、電気けいれん療法は倫理上の懸念から一般的に禁止されて――

key: FATHER: Doctor.
en: FATHER: Doctor.
ja: 父: ドクター。

key: It doesn't escape me that someone in your position has more to gain from maintaining an ailing patient than they do from a successful cure.
en: It doesn't escape me that someone in your position has more to gain from maintaining an ailing patient than they do from a successful cure.
ja: あなたのような立場の人間が、治療を成功させるより、患者を長引かせる方が得をするというのは、私にもわかっているんですよ。
